## PhyloSim-Case study 2-PD

Load the packages

```{r}
library(PhyloSim)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)
library(apTreeshape)
library(picante)
library(cowplot)
```

```{r}
# 1. Running 4 models × 2 dispersal types × 10 replicates

# Initialize 8 empty lists
results_neutral_global    <- list()
results_neutral_local     <- list()
results_density_global    <- list()
results_density_local     <- list()
results_env_global        <- list()
results_env_local         <- list()
results_combined_global   <- list()
results_combined_local    <- list()

for (i in 1:10) {
  cat("Running seed", i, "of 10...\n")
  
  parmBatch <- list(
    # Neutral
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=0, runs=10000,
                      density=0, environment=0, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=1, runs=10000,
                      density=0, environment=0, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    # Density dependent
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=0, runs=10000,
                      density=1, environment=0, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=1, runs=10000,
                      density=1, environment=0, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    # Environmental
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=0, runs=10000,
                      density=0, environment=1, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=1, runs=10000,
                      density=0, environment=1, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    # Combination
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=0, runs=10000,
                      density=1, environment=1, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base"),
    createCompletePar(x=100, y=100, dispersal=1, runs=10000,
                      density=1, environment=1, specRate=5, seed=i, type="base")
  )
  
  simuBatch <- runSimulationBatch(parmBatch, parallel=8)
  
  results_neutral_global[[i]]  <- simuBatch[[1]]
  results_neutral_local[[i]]   <- simuBatch[[2]]
  results_density_global[[i]]  <- simuBatch[[3]]
  results_density_local[[i]]   <- simuBatch[[4]]
  results_env_global[[i]]      <- simuBatch[[5]]
  results_env_local[[i]]       <- simuBatch[[6]]
  results_combined_global[[i]] <- simuBatch[[7]]
  results_combined_local[[i]]  <- simuBatch[[8]]
}
```

```{r}
# 2. Calculate Colless and PD

calc_metrics <- function(simu_list, model_label, dispersal_label) {
  results <- data.frame()
  
  for (i in 1:length(simu_list)) {
    
    tree <- simu_list[[i]]$Output[[1]]$phylogeny
    
    # Colless imbalance
    tree_shape  <- as.treeshape(tree)
    colless_val <- colless(tree_shape, norm = "yule")
    
    # Phylogenetic Diversity
    comm <- matrix(1, nrow=1, ncol=length(tree$tip.label))
    colnames(comm) <- tree$tip.label
    pd_val <- pd(comm, tree)$PD
    
    results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
      seed      = i,
      model     = model_label,
      dispersal = dispersal_label,
      colless   = colless_val,
      pd        = pd_val
    ))
  }
  return(results)
}


```

```{r}
#3.Extract all metrics

metrics_all <- rbind(
  calc_metrics(results_neutral_global,  "Neutral",     "Global"),
  calc_metrics(results_neutral_local,   "Neutral",     "Local"),
  calc_metrics(results_density_global,  "Density Dep", "Global"),
  calc_metrics(results_density_local,   "Density Dep", "Local"),
  calc_metrics(results_env_global,      "Env Filtering", "Global"),
  calc_metrics(results_env_local,       "Env Filtering", "Local"),
  calc_metrics(results_combined_global, "Combination", "Global"),
  calc_metrics(results_combined_local,  "Combination", "Local")
)

#Set the order
metrics_all$model <- factor(metrics_all$model,
                            levels = c("Neutral", "Density Dep", 
                                       "Env Filtering", "Combination"))
metrics_all$dispersal <- factor(metrics_all$dispersal, 
                                levels = c("Global", "Local"))


```

```{r}
# 4.Summary table

summary_table <- metrics_all %>%
  group_by(model, dispersal) %>%
  summarise(
    Colless_mean = round(mean(colless), 3),
    Colless_sd   = round(sd(colless),   3),
    PD_mean      = round(mean(pd),      3),
    PD_sd        = round(sd(pd),        3),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_table)
```

```{r}
#5.Visualization

#Type 1 Boxplot


my_colors <- c(
  "Neutral"       = "pink",
  "Density Dep"   = "darkblue",
  "Env Filtering" = "darkgreen",
  "Combination"   = "orange"
)

# Colless imbalance
p_colless <- ggplot(metrics_all, 
                    aes(x=model, y=colless, fill=model, linetype=dispersal)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=c("Global"="solid", "Local"="dashed")) +
  labs(
    x        = "Model",
    y        = "Colless Imbalance (Yule-normalized)",
    fill     = "Model",
    linetype = "Dispersal"
  ) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
# Phylogenetic Diversity
p_pd <- ggplot(metrics_all, 
               aes(x=model, y=pd, fill=model, linetype=dispersal)) +
  
  geom_boxplot(alpha=0.7, position=position_dodge(width=0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values=my_colors) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values=c("Global"="solid", "Local"="dashed")) +
  labs(
    x        = "Model",
    y        = "Phylogenetic Diversity (PD)",
    fill     = "Model",
    linetype = "Dispersal"
  ) +
  theme_classic()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

plot_grid(
  p_colless, p_pd,
  ncol   = 2,
  labels = c("A", "B")
)
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 6
#| out-width: "100%"



```

```{r}
# Type 2 Dot plot with error bars
#| fig-width: 20    # 加宽
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Figure 2: Colless Imbalance and Phylogenetic Diversity"

my_colors <- c(
  "Neutral"       = "pink",
  "Density Dep"   = "darkblue",
  "Env Filtering" = "darkgreen",
  "Combination"   = "orange"
)

# Colless Imbalance
p_colless <- ggplot(summary_table, 
                    aes(x = model, y = Colless_mean, 
                        color = model, shape = dispersal)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Colless_mean - Colless_sd,
                    ymax = Colless_mean + Colless_sd),
                width    = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Global" = 16, "Local" = 17)) +
  labs(
    x     = "Model",
    y     = "Colless Imbalance (Yule-normalized)",
    color = "Model",
    shape = "Dispersal"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.direction = "vertical"   # ← 竖排
  )

# Phylogenetic Diversity
p_pd <- ggplot(summary_table, 
               aes(x = model, y = PD_mean, 
                   color = model, shape = dispersal)) +
  geom_point(size = 4, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = PD_mean - PD_sd,
                    ymax = PD_mean + PD_sd),
                width    = 0.2,
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = my_colors) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Global" = 16, "Local" = 17)) +
  labs(
    x     = "Model",
    y     = "Phylogenetic Diversity (PD)",
    color = "Model",
    shape = "Dispersal"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )


legend <- get_legend(p_colless)


p_colless_nl <- p_colless + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_pd_nl      <- p_pd      + theme(legend.position = "none")


plot_grid(
  plot_grid(
    p_colless_nl, p_pd_nl,
    ncol   = 2,
    labels = c("A", "B")
  ),
  legend,
  ncol       = 2,           
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.15)   
)
```
